---
name: delivery-evidence-review
description: "Review design or implementation evidence independently."
---
# Procedure

Check source-backed claims, requirement/story/AC/design/task/test traceability and source fingerprint. Review test assertions independently of implementation. Validate actual WAS/Oracle/MQ evidence where required; record skipped/blocked/flaky tests. Produce review findings and recommendation, not a human approval. Request signed review only for concrete artifacts.

# Contract

Read docs/STACK.md and the selected change inputs. Preserve source/requirement references. Persist outputs to changes/CHANGE-ID. Use templates where relevant. Do not modify controls or self-approve. Report blockers with the decision needed and affected artifacts.
